owners.guidance: Entry composition and generic workflow remain; add a distinct cohesive rich document lifecycle inside the existing feature. Do not branch by product=Newsletter alone: prospect origin and rich/generic identities are different.
Reuse labels/actions/status/error/retry/modal focus and adopted Radix primitives. Modal return focus only to connected opener. No old Modal/router/auth restoration.

Fixed operation request/response boundary, scoped abort, no automatic mutation retries, current query-only data. Rich backend DTO adapters/decoders and necessary multipart descriptors are root-owned additions.

Current session/org/client remount and service-verified selected-client semantics. Document/review/stage route lifetime still needs a domain key; routeClientId recognizes modules but not historical /workspace URLs, so thin compatibility routes must redirect/compose deliberately.

Reuse only where the rich operation has a matching explicit replay contract. Domain verifies current actor/source before hydration/dispatch and binds original receipt. Do not rename saved-version fields or invent idempotency for create/save.

Use the installed immutable two-export package. Qualification workspace is test-only, not app import target. Canonical types/render/sanitization, font/social helpers own semantics; feature owns local selection/draft state. Package interface types do not replace runtime receipt validation.

owners.existing: Proposed draft/revision hook, canvas/selected-block, preview/review and later assets/image tools
owners.guidance: Separate real lifecycle responsibilities, not line-count shards. Original NewsletterEditor is3296 nonblank lines; copy as reference only. Coordinate root routes/shared styles/operation/schema/registry files before edits.

rootCoordination: Rich fixed operation names/validators and optional upload paths
